args.title: Normalize line endings to support Windows CRLF CSV uploads
args.body: Proposed change in src/ingest/parser.ts: normalize line endings by stripping trailing carriage returns (\r) or splitting on CRLF/LF so that Windows-exported files with \r\n line endings do not retain trailing \r characters on rows and headers, preventing false "Malformed row" shape validation errors.

result: Opened draft pull request 4 from repomind/issue-4203 for issue 4203.

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The new Windows export tool likely produces files with carriage return (CRLF, `\r\n`) line endings instead of LF (`\n`). In `parseStatement`, `text.split("\n")` leaves a trailing carriage return (`\r`) on every line, including the header row and data rows. When `splitFields` processes the last field or header column, the trailing `\r` remains attached, causing `fields.length !== header.length` or mismatched column counts and triggering the `errors.rowShape` ("Malformed row") exception. Normalizing line endings by stripping `\r` will resolve this.
